claim_boundary: New generated layouts on previously inspected motion sources; no motion-source transfer, physical feasibility, closed-loop result, or hardware claim.

generation.rng: Python random.Random (MT19937), uniform draws, round to 9 decimal places
generation.course_order: 12 courses,first then second beam; assign source_ids[index % 3]
generation.geometry_units: metres and radians; route progress is normalized neutral-reference XY arc length
generation.range_rationale: A priori static overhead variation in length,placement,height; no success- or clearance-conditioned selection

splits.source_assignment: 8 single layouts and4 two-beam compositions per development source
splits.train_and_validation_exclusions: All exact evaluation layouts/compositions and their perturbations,branches,frames,derived labels; no outcome or teacher query on these layouts during tuning

source_heldout.reason: No audited new-source ancestry and transition qualification. Reserve separately before claiming motion-source transfer.

known_geometry_audit.scope: Top-level m2s manifest/registration geometry plus clean development groups; identity on route_progress,underside,length rounded to9decimals; no outcome inspection for generation
known_geometry_audit.limitation: Not an exhaustive audit of every historical scratch file, inherited prior, or approximate geometric similarity. New exact layouts are not a new-source guarantee.

evaluation.main_panel: nominal offset only,all36 layouts x2 physics seeds; course execution held until continuation interface qualified
evaluation.stress_panel: all8 nonzero axis offsets for every layout and physics seed,separately reported; no additions to main denominator
evaluation.course_perturbation_application: Apply the same delta independently to both beam parameter records; never relabel nominal success as perturbed success
evaluation.feasibility_filter: none; retain all geometries; mark unsupported runtime as not_run,never as a passing/failing rollout
evaluation.course_rendering: Instantiate both beams together and run one continuous episode; never stitch independently reset passages

construction_contract.positive: minimum signed executed-envelope clearance over the9 finite offsets >=margin
construction_contract.observation: causal delivered sensor evidence before empirically qualified transition deadline; timing rule fixed in implementation lock
construction_contract.physical_labels: every compared option receives an actual matched-context branch; geometry never substituted for physical passage
construction_contract.screen_ablation: old all-offset contrast may be reported separately,never confused with the revised objective

acquisition.primary_budget_unit: actual physics integration steps advanced across every new teacher,student,positive,negative,failed,reset and rejected-execution branch; record control frames separately
acquisition.budget_rule: Count all branches; only begin a matched group when its predeclared maximum step cost fits the remaining budget; do not silently exceed or truncate a group
acquisition.shared_option_qualification_cost: Record once and allocate equally across arm reporting; inherited corpus and reuse are separately disclosed

priority_mixture.coverage_key: teacher option x declared obstacle-length stratum x timing-eligibility class
priority_mixture.unknown_gap: zero regret weight; diagnostic role only without admissible teacher target

common_implementation.status: pending separate immutable implementation lock before evaluation or method tuning on evaluation outcomes
common_implementation.retained_tracker: frozen SONIC,identical checkpoint+simulator+robot hashes across all arms
initial_action_interface: one qualified adaptation reference at repeated legal entry/return points
common_implementation.qualification_rule: Empty-scene transition qualification only; same admitted options for every curriculum/baseline; select no option using locked evaluation outcomes
common_implementation.sensor: 35 rays from one body-mounted sensor pose with measured surface normals; causal floor/ceiling and occupancy history with separate observed/unknown masks
common_implementation.initial_learner: guarded2-class linear readout; passage-first teacher then measured passage-time regret weighted cross entropy; corpus-specific normalization fitted only on training data
common_implementation.multi_reference_policy: not integrated; separate frozen implementation required before using an expanded action set
common_implementation.course_continuation: not qualified; no course execution/ranking until implementation lock includes supported repeated transitions and horizon
required_implementation_lock_fields: qualified common options and entry/return guards
teacher branch horizon and matched restoration procedure
timing evidence rule and empirical transition delay/margins
physics dt/control dt/contact logger and scoring implementation
continuous single/course horizon and intervention rules

comparison_matrix.acceptance: common executable positive support and observation validity; no explicit contrast targeting
common positive support and observation validity; no negative alternative condition

comparison_matrix.scene_proposal: same analytic alternatives with sensor deadline admission
comparison_matrix.acceptance: common revised screen plus causally available decision

comparison_matrix.scene_proposal: conditional mixture fitted to same analytic exemplars,all search/fit charged
resample/jitter the same accepted analytic exemplars

fixed_baselines: constant_adaptation with the same applicable qualified duration/return interface
scripted sensor policy tuned only on development
finite privileged teacher upper comparator; no global optimality claim

isolating_ablations.sensor_representation: fixed corpus,options,training; current-frame rays vs common temporal representation
isolating_ablations.dataset_aggregation: same initial corpus; initial imitation vs additional matched teacher labels on student states,all steps counted

scoring.passage: complete assigned course within timeout,without reset/disqualifying beam contact/fall/illegal command
scoring.body_completion: all recorded body origins beyond downstream edge of final beam plus0.1m; collider extents not implied
scoring.missing_torque: unknown,never zero; mechanical work is not battery energy

analysis.primary_unit: layout/composition; physics seeds are repeats; independently acquired corpus is a separate replication axis
analysis.pairing: same layout,source,physics seed and implementation across arms
analysis.reporting: numerator/denominator by task stratum and source; course-level paired difference with uncertainty; separate acquisition-corpus variability
claim_constraints: no source-heldout claim on these development carriers
no lookup evaluation for sequential policies
no physical robustness from finite geometry screens
no continuous-course result from stitched/reset trajectories
no post-outcome geometry selection or discarded impossible cases

amendments.rule: Never overwrite this recipe; any substantive change writes a new version citing this SHA256 and states whether prior evaluation outcomes were inspected
amendments.implementation_lock: May complete runtime details in a separate hash-linked file without changing locked geometry; freeze before running this evaluation
amendments.test_use: Any teacher/model/curriculum adaptation using these layouts invalidates their untouched status and must be disclosed
